embeds.title: PSBL WINTER MEETINGS
embeds.description: The yearly owners' meeting, held in the Offseason before the amendment window opens.

fields.name: WHEN
fields.value: **`[TIMESTAMP]`** • RSVP on the Sesh event in **📅│league-calendar**

fields.name: AGENDA
fields.value: Season review • Ideas from **💡│league-suggestions** that could become amendment proposals (Article XX) • Draft and calendar dates • Open floor

fields.name: CAN'T MAKE IT
fields.value: Notes are posted in **💬│gm-lounge** afterward. Nothing is decided at the meeting itself: rule changes still go through a written proposal and a vote.
